_sobre: Uma pose por miniatura, escrita à mão: a técnica do clã e o jeito do personagem na arte dele (o bestiário), sem repetir pose dentro do clã. `quem` substitui a descrição tirada do pedido da arte quando ele não segue o padrão (Nível Anbu, alguns Jounin e Líderes).

cla-aburame--genin.pose: standing quietly with one hand in his coat pocket, the other hand raised at chest height with a single beetle resting on his outstretched index finger, looking at it calmly

cla-aburame--chunin.pose: standing straight like a scholar, holding an open glass insect jar in one hand and its lid in the other, a thin stream of tiny black insects rising out of the jar

cla-aburame--jounin.pose: a wide confident grin, both arms stretched out to the sides with open palms, dark swarms of tiny insects pouring out of his sleeves

cla-aburame--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Aburame clan ANBU of Konoha, a tall man in a dark high-collared hooded coat over the Konoha ANBU gear (grey armored vest, long black arm guards), round dark sunglasses under the hood
cla-aburame--nivel-anbu.pose: standing still with his arms crossed over his chest, a thin cloud of tiny black beetles drifting out from under his hood

cla-aburame--lider-do-cla.pose: standing calmly with both hands clasped behind his back, a small column of insects spiraling around his feet, stern and patient

cla-akimichi--lider-do-cla.pose: standing tall and huge with both fists clenched at his sides, faint butterfly-shaped chakra wings glowing on his back, calm and powerful
